brief:
A veteran political commentator has declared the election results mark the conclusion of Benjamin Netanyahu's political dominance in Israel, according to Middle East Eye. Meron Rapoport stated with certainty that Netanyahu cannot serve as the next prime minister, characterizing the outcome as "the end of the Netanyahu era."

The assessment reflects significant shifts in Israeli electoral politics following the latest vote count. Rapoport's declaration suggests a pivotal moment in the country's political landscape.
dek: Veteran commentator says results mark ‘end of the Netanyahu era’ Veteran political commentator Meron Rapoport declared the results "the end of the Netanyahu era". "He cannot be the next prime minister, that’s 100 percent sure.
title: Israeli commentator declares Netanyahu era over after election results
